AGENTS · PROJECT

Agents in investment management

A video walkthrough of an investment platform with agents at its core.

Has anybody already built agents built into an online investment platform?

THE PROJECT · 1 VIDEO

The question

What do agents mean for an online investment platform beyond the chatbot in the corner?

The approach

Treat the agent as an application that senses, thinks and acts, reasoning through many steps the way a person would, built into the core of the experience.

The tradeoff

Finance needs trust and clarity, so agent actions must stay explainable.

What to take with you

An agent isn’t a face with eyes. It’s software that can sense, think and act.
